column3: Believing in Victory
As long as you give it your all, we won't lose.
However, don't forget that a single moment of negligence can be fatal.
Hmm? Could it be that she...
She's not just saying it to me, could it be that she's saying that to ease her own stress?
That's understandable. Even for Kuroneko, there's no way you can't be nervous once you get this far.
I'll show her that I too can be reliable.
Thank you, Kuroneko.
Why are you expressing your gratitude...?
It's fine if you don't know why.
Anyway, thank you.
Kuroneko, I'm somehow getting enthusiastic all of a sudden!
Don't voice the obvious, please.
Kuroneko is very reliable once she gets like that.
Sorry to have kept you both waiting!
What's wrong, Saori?
From what it seems, the opponents you will face in the finals are steadily ranked in the top 10 nation-wide!
W-What did you say?!
In other words, I'm saying that your opponents are two people on Kuroneko's level.
S-Seriously...?
How is it possible to win against such opponents...?
Fighting spirit!
...Fighting spirit?
That's right. Win with your fighting spirit!
Since you beat us, you definitely have to win!
I heard that line before.
You bear the responsibility of winning after defeating your previous foes.
This girl... She's always been like that.
Thanks, Kirino. Thanks to you, we made a breakthrough. Isn't that right, Kuroneko?
Losing is not an option, hence we must win. That unreasonable logic is really like you.
But... I don't particularly dislike it.
It's not like I'm doing that for the both of you...
I'm just cheering for you; I'll be mad if you lose!
Kirino...
For a girl that isn't usually honest, she went so far!
With this, we can only grab a complete victory!
You don't have to tell me that. Simply enjoy my beautiful massacre from your VIP seat.
Okay! Let's go with our fighting spirit!
Our goal is nothing but victory!
